description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill list entries and inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Dolly Defender
sections.description_summary: Stitchy fights alongside Daimon, automatically attacking the nearest enemy. Active cast: Stitchy slashes an X-shaped area for max-HP-based true damage; Daimon and two weakest allies gain shields based on damage dealt.

sections.name: Playtime Plunder
sections.description_summary: Stitchy periodically deals max-HP-based true damage to the target and adjacent enemies; damage converts to Daimon's shield. Active cast: Daimon drains the target's max HP and converts it to a shield.

sections.name: Buddy Barrier
sections.description_summary: Bonds with the ally placed behind Daimon during preparation. When Daimon gains a shield, the bonded ally receives a portion; while shielded by Daimon, the bonded ally gains Life Drain and ATK. Re-bonds to the weakest ally if the companion is defeated.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases damage reduction; grants extra reduction while shielded.

sections.name: Guardian Growl
sections.description_summary: When cumulative damage taken and shield loss exceed a threshold, Stitchy returns and frightens nearby enemies plus the enemy who dealt the most damage to Daimon.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: When an allied hero's shield expires, converts half of the remaining shield into healing for that hero.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases shield value and grants Phys/Magic DEF when shielding; higher ranks also heal based on shield value.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate low-HP mitigation/healing effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Splashing Fun
sections.description_summary: Splashes spring water within 2 tiles, healing allies and damaging enemies; enemies are slept. Healing received from the hot spring extends sleep duration, up to a cap.

sections.name: Spring Therapy
sections.description_summary: Opening leap and ground stomp damages and interrupts enemies, then creates a hot spring. Allies in it heal over time; enemies also recover a small capped amount of HP.

sections.name: Mighty Smash
sections.description_summary: Damages and stuns an enemy; Gerda gains a shield.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases damage reduction.

sections.name: Spring of Life
sections.description_summary: Increases healing received from allied hot spring; each ally heal reduces Mighty Smash cooldown. Higher level makes allies unaffected briefly when entering the spring for the first time.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Spring Therapy's stomp stuns instead of interrupting. LV 2 grants a first-entry shield to allies in the hot spring, with further shields per healing instance and a per-ally cap.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Deals magic damage to adjacent enemies and heals Gerda; higher ranks add opening unaffected duration.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate low-HP mitigation/healing effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Princess' Rally
sections.description_summary: Summons two royal guards that inherit Peggy's HP and ATK. Active cast heals remaining guards and orders them to protect all allies; 70% of ally damage taken is shared among guards, whose own HP loss is reduced.

sections.name: Royal Scroll
sections.description_summary: Heals remaining royal guards and the two weakest allies over 8 s.

sections.name: Royal Barrage
sections.description_summary: Summons a royal marksman in the backline to attack two frontmost enemies with armor-piercing arrows. Hit enemies take increased ranged damage; allied summons gain an additional ranged-damage bonus against them.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste; grants extra Haste while two royal guards remain.

sections.name: Royal Protection
sections.description_summary: Royal guards use sword moves while Princess' Rally is active, dealing AOE damage and gaining shields. LV 3 creates a glory aura increasing melee damage for allies, with an extra bonus for allied summons.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: When at least three allied summons from different allies are alive, all allied summons gain ATK and Phys/Magic DEF based on Peggy's initial stats.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK and Phys/Magic DEF for the caster and created units; higher ranks add Haste after 5 s.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a first-low-HP ally heal/shield and refine stats.

sections.name: Killer Flush
sections.description_summary: Launches 15 leaf cards at an enemy, each dealing ATK damage plus extra damage based on the target's lost HP. Ravion is unaffected while casting.

sections.name: Designated Duty
sections.description_summary: Assigns an Objective to each of two rearmost allies. Completing an objective by damage, assist or defeat restores Energy and grants ATK based on Ravion's initial ATK. After both complete, Ravion activates Mortal Ace against the enemy with the highest cumulative damage, reducing ATK/Phys DEF and striking/knocking down.

sections.name: Phantom Gambit
sections.description_summary: Teleports three times; the first two arrivals damage the densest enemy tiles, and the third moves Ravion to a tile farthest from enemies.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK; grants extra ATK after the first Mortal Ace.

sections.name: Shadow Patron
sections.description_summary: After the first Mortal Ace, permanently increases Haste and ATK for Ravion and allies who completed Objectives. LV 3 prevents the first fatal blow to Ravion or an objective ally, grants shield/Life Drain, and may swap the ally with Ravion.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: When an ally accepts an Objective, increases ATK and makes them unaffected for 5 s.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Ravion's own-skill displacement grants ATK; higher ranks also grant a shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Rearmost-ally targeting order
sections.description_summary: The page specifies the rearmost-ally scan order by row and hex ID; the exact ordering rule is retained as a separate targeting record.

sections.name: Ravaging Claws
sections.description_summary: Morphs into wolf, knocks the target airborne and damages enemies within 2 tiles. While in Wolf Form, creates Lupine Aura; Shakir's normal attacks hit a frontal area, allies in the aura take less damage and gain Haste. Maintaining wolf form consumes Energy per second.

sections.name: Savage Cleave
sections.description_summary: Performs three consecutive strikes; in Wolf Form, damages enemies in a frontal arc.

sections.name: Wolf's Will
sections.description_summary: Provides passive Ranged DEF; in Wolf Form Shakir is unaffected and gains Life Drain. Each non-summoned ally in Lupine Aura grants Shakir ATK.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases damage reduction; grants extra reduction when at least two non-summoned allies are buffed by Lupine Aura.

sections.name: All-Conquering
sections.description_summary: Can cast Ultimate above the Energy threshold and remains in Wolf Form without Energy cost for a period after Ultimate. Higher rank shares Wolf's Will ATK bonus with allies in the aura.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: The third hit of Savage Cleave reduces target Vitality for 4 s.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Every 8 s increases ATK and Life Drain for allies within 2 tiles; higher ranks add a shield for Shakir per ally affected.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Eternal Dreamscape
sections.description_summary: Creates a 3.5 s dream hypnotizing all enemies; they cannot move or act and take damage over time.

sections.name: Dream Dance
sections.description_summary: Consumes part of current HP to damage and stun adjacent enemies, then flies to the farthest enemy and repeats the effect with reduced damage against targets hit twice.

sections.name: Fluttering Dream
sections.description_summary: When Tasi loses 50% HP, enters the dream realm and transforms into a butterfly, becoming invincible, recovering HP and damaging adjacent enemies. Can trigger twice per battle.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK; grants extra ATK while Eternal Dreamscape lasts.

sections.name: Shimmering Dust
sections.description_summary: After Ultimate, gains Haste and damage reduction; Dream Dance no longer costs HP or has cooldown during this window and prioritizes the farthest hypnotized enemy.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Each assist/defeat of a non-summoned enemy grants an extra Fluttering Dream attempt.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides Energy recovery per second; after three Ultimates adds ATK, with higher ranks adding true damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine effects.

sections.name: Divine Rend
sections.description_summary: Marches three tiles in the chosen direction, striking adjacent enemies repeatedly and pushing them along the path; ends with a shield bash that damages and stuns enemies within 1 tile. Perseus is unaffected while casting.

capture_status_notes: The capture excerpt ends during Ultimate level scaling. Remaining abilities, Hero Focus, Exclusive Equipment, Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode require recapture.
